simple.meaning: אָנָה (ʼânâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to groan.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 3:26. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָנָה (H578) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָנָה (ʼânâh) / H578 is traced through Isaiah 3:26, Isaiah 19:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Her gates shall lament and mourn.
